name: ShinMaywa Industries, Ltd.
summary: ShinMaywa Industries, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of work vehicles in Japan, Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Specially equipped vehicles, Parking System, Industrial Machinery and Environmental Systems, Fluid, and Aircraft segments. The company offers amphibian and aircraft components; and special purpose trucks, such as dump trucks, refuse compactors, detachable container system series, tail gate lifters, concrete mixers, tanks, and sewerage cleaning trucks; and fluid and related facilities and equipment, including pumps, essentials for water treatment, and remote monitoring systems.
